subject: How to add the overall temporal effect and overall site effect in the "prediction" stack?

messages.author: 35e8084e6030f728
messages.subject: How to add the overall temporal effect and overall site effect in the "prediction" stack?
parts:
Hello:  INLA creator

I am wondering how to add the overall temporal effect and overall site effect in the "prediction" stack? We have 130 sampling points, and the time point is 25. Here are the code:

n_station<-130
n_weeks<-25
n_data<-130*25
station.id<-rep(1:130,25)
timeindex<-rep(1:n_weeks, each=n_station)
coordinates.allyear <- as.matrix(sta[station.id,c("x","y")])

A_est <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh=mesh,
                          loc=coordinates.allyear,
                          group=timeindex,
                          n.group=n_weeks)

s_index <- inla.spde.make.index(name="s",
                                n.spde=spde$n.spde,
                                n.group=n_weeks)

#overall temporal effect and overall site effect
index <- data.frame(time.index=timeindex,
                                    site.index=station.id) 

stack_est<-inla.stack(tag="est",
                        data=list(y=result),
                        A=list(A_est,1),
                        effects=list(c(s_index,list(b=1)),list(cor,index))) #cor is the corvariate

#For prediction
iweek<- 1

A_pre <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh=mesh,
                          loc=as.matrix(ncoor1),
                          group=iweek,
                          n.group=n_weeks)

stack_pred<-inla.stack(tag="pre",
                  data=list(y=NA),
                  A=list(A_pre,1),
                  effects=list(c(s_index,list(b=1)),list(ncor))) #how to add the index in "pre" stack

formula <- y~ -1+b+P65+P15+Density+
                  f(site.index,model='iid')+
                  f(time.index,model="ar1")+
                  f(s, model=spde,group=s.group, control.group=list(model="ar1"))

Kind regards

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] How to add the overall temporal effect and overall site effect in the "prediction" stack?
parts:
Your model needs to include the prediction timepoint, I.e n_weeks needs to cover both the observed weeks and the prediction week index. The prediction stack should then have exactly the same structure as the estimation stack, except for y=NA.

Finn
